## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
You must fix "Restore the False result for empty criteria" before merge: `requirement_proven([])` now returns `True`, which contradicts the description's "No behavior change is intended". The 178 record handlers listed under `## Not reviewed` were checked by pattern search only.

## Changes
The pull request replaces `typing.List`/`typing.Dict` with built-in generics and `log.warn` with `log.warning` across 180 `app/handlers/h*_records.py` files and `h091_requirements.py`. It also switches `by_name` to `operator.itemgetter`, rewrites the return expression of `requirement_proven` as a sum-and-compare, and adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — Restore the False result for empty criteria — `requirement_proven([])` now returns `True`, where the base returned `False`. The removed `bool(criteria) and all(...)` guarded the empty list; `sum(...) == len(criteria)` evaluates `0 == 0` after line 10 logs "requirement has no criteria". — A requirement with no criteria now counts as proven in release review, and no test covers the empty list. — Fix: Return `bool(criteria) and all(item["proven"] for item in criteria)` and extend `test_requirement_proof` with the empty-list case.
